card.name: Comparisons pointing to a past time
card.fires_on: Words in general web text where a comparison with an earlier period or a historical statement is being set up, such as 'than there', 'than it', 'more than', 'compared with 23 percent', or 'In' before a past year. Fires just before a past date or era is named.

modes.label: Than-comparisons with the past
modes.description: The word 'than' or the word right after it, in a comparison with an earlier time.

modes.label: Lead-in to a past year or era
modes.description: Small words or spaces just before a past year or historical detail.
